  "next_check":"id_check",
  "memo":"Only R03 holds: issuing-country/IP mismatch and failed CVV establish the Card family. No other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. A legitimate home-based customer using a foreign-issued card remains plausible; prior card use does not establish the current purchaser's identity. Under FP-2 §6.6(b), recommend needs_check with issuer authentication and identity verification. Contact is not required. The order has already shipped, so the check cannot pause shipment or prevent the existing exposure. A passed id_check requires clear; failure requires decline because Linkage is absent."
